changes.summary: Imported the third sub-batch of the M3 Wave 2 migration (task 4.5a) -- the roving-focus group: Accordion, RadioGroup, and Tabs. All three already depend on this crate's existing private `collection` module (collection_item, use_item, CollectionOptions/CollectionState, use_collection_provider/use_collection_provider_with), the same shared roving-focus infrastructure already imported for Select in M1 and reused by DropdownMenu/ContextMenu/Menubar in Wave 3 -- confirmed by reading the actual upstream source (each file's own `use crate::collection::{...}` import), not assumed from the migration queue's one-line descriptions. No new shared primitive was needed; this validates the migration queue's Wave 3 note that this infrastructure generalizes. accordion.rs dropped the one upstream-internal `use crate::dioxus_elements::Key;` import (a re-export path specific to upstream's own crate layout that does not exist here) since `Key` already resolves through the existing `use dioxus::prelude::*` glob import, matching every other keyboard-handling primitive in this crate. radio_group.rs and tabs.rs needed no adaptation at all beyond the doc-example import path change from `dioxus_primitives` to `adico_primitives`. None of the three uses `document::eval`, a portal, or a DOM measurement API, so all three are SSR-safe by construction; no target-gated adapter work was needed. Verified for native (SSR-safe default), `--features web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, and `--features desktop`.

Imported toggle_group.rs into the same sub-batch once its hard dependency (`crate::toggle::Toggle`, imported in the concurrent Wave 2 state sub-batch, commit 6664368) landed. ToggleGroup/ToggleItem compose the collection roving-focus infrastructure exactly like Accordion/RadioGroup/Tabs above and the existing owned Toggle primitive directly (matching the migration queue's Wave 5 color-picker precedent of a registry item composing another owned primitive as a plain Rust dependency, not a registry dependency edge). Ported unmodified beyond the doc-example import path change. SSR-safe by construction; no target-gated adapter work needed.
